provides: Conditional on aggregate N, each species consists of independent labelled particles performing the original symmetric edge walks at rate delta_i. Tensorization and quotienting to counts preserve Poincare. For connected undirected simple n-vertex graphs, the combinatorial Laplacian gap is>=2/[n(n-1)] when n>1. Therefore H=E_pi_bar Var_muN(f)<=n^2/delta_min E_diff(f), uniformly in every count and rare actual class. At n=1 the fibre has one state and H=0. No normalized-time random walk or graph expansion promise changes the physical clock.

Original local rates are kappa_r V^(1-a_r)(x_v)_y and each oriented-edge diffusion rate is delta_i*x_vi. W=nV, A=max(1,max source/target arities). Actual classes are enabled-rule classes, not saturated fibres. For sampling/endpoint interfaces, volumes, populations, accuracy and physical time are binary inputs and all output/access/randomness costs are paid.
